_comment: Hand-tuned GAME ratings layered on top of rule-derived ratings (racingsim/tracks/ratings.py). Keys are track IDs. These are internal simulation choices informed by research and broadcasts' common descriptions, NOT official specifications. Optional display_name renames a venue without touching facts.

daytona-international-speedway-fl.rationale: 2.5-mi, 31-deg superspeedway: pack drafting, multi-car crashes; premier event venue.

talladega-superspeedway-al.rationale: Longest, highest-banked oval; strongest draft in the game.

atlanta-motor-speedway-ga.rationale: Reprofiled in 2022 to 28-deg banking; races like a superspeedway.

martinsville-speedway-va.rationale: Flat paperclip: hardest braking zones on the schedule, bump-and-run racing, track position.

bristol-motor-speedway-tn.rationale: High-banked concrete half mile: high-g, frequent cautions, nowhere to hide from wrecks.

darlington-raceway-sc.rationale: Egg-shaped, abrasive surface: tire management and wall contact define the race.

indianapolis-motor-speedway-in.rationale: Flat 2.5-mi rectangle; aero and horsepower dominate; most prestigious open-wheel venue.

richmond-raceway-va.rationale: Worn D-shaped 0.75 mi: heavy tire falloff.

pocono-raceway-pa.rationale: Three distinct corners: setup compromise and fuel strategy.

watkins-glen-international-ny.rationale: Fast road course with long straights.

road-america-wi.rationale: 4-mile high-speed road course; drafting on long straights.

sonoma-raceway-ca.rationale: Hilly, low-grip road course; tire falloff.

sebring-international-raceway-fl.rationale: Bumpy former airfield; hardest endurance test on equipment.

eldora-speedway-oh.rationale: High-banked half-mile dirt; crown-jewel dirt venue.

knoxville-raceway-ia.rationale: Home of the most prestigious 410 sprint car event.

five-flags-speedway-fl.rationale: Crown-jewel super late model race is a tire-management test.

slinger-speedway-wi.rationale: High-banked quarter mile: fast and frantic.

bowman-gray-stadium-nc.rationale: Flat quarter-mile around a football field; contact racing.

homestead-miami-speedway-fl.rationale: Progressive banking creates multiple grooves; worn surface.

oxford-plains-speedway-me.rationale: Hosts New England's biggest one-day short-track race.

tulsa-expo-raceway-ok.rationale: Indoor 1/5-mile clay oval; premier midget event.

laguna-seca-raceway-ca.rationale: Short, technical road course with few passing zones.

road-atlanta-ga.rationale: Fast, hilly road course; endurance crown-jewel venue.
